commit.message: ci(compat): verify Magi against pinned Hermes release matrix

specification.objective: MAGI-014: exact GitHub release and source refs on isolated GitHub Actions Hermes compatibility matrix for minimum 0.21.5, existing pinned commit, and latest stable v0.22.5 (selected 2026-10-23).

requirements.statement: Matrix contains three checked exact refs: Hermes v0.21.5 release actually tagged v2026.9.24 commit f97608f..., current pinned 517b5e..., latest GitHub stable v0.22.5 commit bf0203a...; never infer v0.21.5 tag.

Each matrix version is independently fetched and installed without source modifications; check git HEAD exact SHA and public MemoryStore APIs through temporary profile, then run same Magi verification and Desktop interaction tests.

Required stable baseline and pinned jobs remain blocking; latest stable is explicitly informative initially; record local installed test evidence, observed failures/limitations and how declared requires_hermes floor is supported.
Wait for asynchronous editor draft state before asserting Save disabled in prior MAGI-012 interaction test, which reproducibly fails in isolated POLIS checkout.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Regression fails when matrix and exact refs missing, and passes when all three verified snapshots and isolated GitHub jobs exist.
Probe runs native Hermes MemoryStore operations for memory and user on temporary profile and reports clear failures; same ./verify.sh and Desktop suite run for each matrix job.
README and versioned compatibility doc contain precise SHA, release tags, tested functions, observed statuses and missing evidence; no upstream Hermes source edits or Magi version bump.
Stored editor regression handles async query selection and CI isolated tests remain stable.

invariants.statement: Magi version 1.7.8 and all previous 013/020/012 commits stay unchanged; no Hermes source patches.

forbidden_states.statement: Use floating Hermes latest at CI runtime, accept missing SHA, or claim 0.21.5 tag exists.

inputs.statement: GitHub official releases/latest 2026-10-23T05:28:45Z tag v0.22.5, remotes refs/tags/v0.22.5^{} bf0203a..., v2026.9.24^{} f97608f..., existing pinned SHA 517b5e...

outputs.statement: Isolated GitHub Actions matrix, native no-real-profile compatibility probe, regression tests and documentation.

failure_semantics.statement: Any missing/incorrect SHA or required version missing API fails its job; informational latest failures remain visible and documented.
